scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.dev:fresh: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspace shared && npm run test --workspace server
scripts.sample:questions: npm run build --workspace shared && node shared/scripts/sample-questions.mjs
